title: Richest Customer Wealth
goal: Find the greatest total bank balance held by one customer.
strategy: Sum bank balances separately for each customer. Compare completed row totals rather than individual balances.

phasePurposes.inspect: Sum bank balances separately for each customer. Compare completed row totals rather than individual balances.
phasePurposes.update: Each row total is one customer’s wealth; the maximum total wins.
phasePurposes.done: Each row total is one customer’s wealth; the maximum total wins.
